text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is our third summer camp together, and Admire Vega is determined to train harder than ever for the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I, on the other hand, am not feeling great. Admire Vega notices my predicament and advises me to get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems some of her sisterly kindness is starting to surface.
